authorization: PM explicitly resumes and requests BTC observable regimes and strategy selection
known_history: All historical data is adaptive exploration; no fresh OOS

state.efficiency_definition: abs(sum(last60 log returns))/sum(abs(last60 log returns)); zero path=0
state.trend_direction: sign of last60 log return sum
state.volatility_threshold: strictly above prior365 rolling20d annualized vol 75th percentile; require180 prior estimates; excludes today
state.available_at: completed UTC daily close, modeled final-bar availability; target executed >=1h later
state.warmup: unknown -> no risk; do not fill holes

purpose: Conditional attribution of already observed fixed walk-forward returns, not deployable switching PnL
attribution: For return closing dayD, state known at start of dayD. Existing strategies retain carried inventory. Conditional means are not resettable strategy portfolios. Include six cells even empty; min60 labeled days per cell flagged.
statistics: Descriptive means, rms, worst day, day counts, transitions/duration; no significance or selecting best expert per cell. No optimal hindsight or rule tuning.
stop: No strategy promotion based on conditional attribution; grid execution and inherited bar/fill limits remain.
